name: Hugging Face CLI
description: Installs the Hugging Face CLI with its standalone installer for the remote user, optionally with the upstream hf-cli agent skill.

version.description: The huggingface_hub release: latest, resolved at build time, or a stable MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH at or above 1.27.0.

installSkill.description: Generate the upstream hf-cli agent skill in the remote user's home and link it into ~/.claude/skills.
